description: This Java class 'ModelInfo' models the <entitymodel> XML elements providing default values and metadata for entity models in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to create instances from XML attributes or child elements, and contains metadata fields like title, description, copyright, author, version, and default resource name.

classes.name: ModelInfo
classes.description: Immutable class representing entity model metadata and default values, with methods to instantiate from XML attributes or elements.

methods.name: createFromAttributes
methods.description: Creates a ModelInfo instance from XML attributes, using defaults for missing values.

methods.name: createFromElements
methods.description: Creates a ModelInfo instance from XML child elements, using defaults for missing values.

methods.name: getCopyrightString
methods.description: Generates a copyright string with the current year.
